evidence.observation: The (p1) design says references are bound by `bind_declared_references(model, root=reference_root or model_path.parent)`, and IR1-C8 requires a reference file available only under `--reference-root`. The pending phase-IR1-spec.md:95–97 instead directs `model = load_model_bytes_composed(mr, source=model_path, root=root)`. That loader binds references under the model directory before the separate reference root can be used.

concerns.recommendation: Revise the IR1 draft spec to use `_load_model_at` for composition without eager reference binding, and add IR1-C8 to its gate tests before approving the spec.
concerns.title: Pending IR1 spec contradicts the repaired reference-root design

summary: The r3 plan resolves the separate reference-root issue, but the pending IR1 draft spec still directs the conflicting loader.
